description.value: An fMRI cue-reactivity study examined neural responses to tobacco, monetary, and neutral cues in male daily smokers.

spans.text: The current fMRI study sought to clarify the neural activity reflecting tobacco-specific incentive value versus domain-general incentive value by examining smoking cues, neutral cues, and a third set of cues, monetary cues

spans.text: Motion-corrected datasets were normalized into Talairach space ( ), and individual volumes from the run were registered to a base volume proximal to acquisition of the anatomical dataset ( ). The raw BOLD signal was scaled to percent signal change from the mean signal intensity.
